values: 佐尔娅周期性地在休眠状态和苏醒状态中切换，每次苏醒时降临在敌人附近造成伤害。
Zorya alternates between dormant and awake states. Every time she awakens, she jumps to near enemies and deals damage.

被动地，佐尔娅的各项技能威力强大且冷却时间较短，但仅在自身苏醒期间可以使用。进入战斗时自身处于休眠状态，休眠期间处于无敌，且每秒恢复85点能量值和7%最大生命值。能量满时，佐尔娅会苏醒并参与战斗，期间自身处于稳定，每秒消耗70点能量值。在能量值耗尽后会再次休眠。除本技能以外的其他来源的能量增减效果不会影响佐尔娅的能量，但每10点其他来源的能量恢复永久增加自身1%攻击力，最多叠加100层。每次佐尔娅苏醒时，会降临在敌方最密集区域，并对周围2格范围内的敌人造成300% + 4% ATK伤害和2秒眩晕。

Passive. Zorya's skills are powerful and have short cooldowns, but she can only use them while awake.
When a battle starts, Zorya enters a dormant state. While dormant, she remains invincible and recovers 85 Energy and 7% max HP per second. Once her Energy is full, Zorya awakens and joins the fight.

Every time Zorya awakens, she jumps to the area with the most enemies, dealing 300% + 4% ATK damage to enemies within 2 tiles and stunning them for 2s. While awake, she is steadfast and consumes 70 Energy per second. When her Energy is fully depleted, she returns to her dormant state.

Zorya's Energy cannot be modified by sources other than this skill. Instead, for every 10 Energy she would have gained, her ATK permanently increases by 1%, stacking up to 100 times.
佐尔娅降临时的伤害提升至320% + 4% ATK。
Increases Zorya's landing damage to 320% + 4% ATK.
佐尔娅降临时的伤害提升至340% + 4% ATK。
Increases Zorya's landing damage to 340% + 4% ATK.
佐尔娅降临时的伤害提升至360% + 4% ATK。
Increases Zorya's landing damage to 360% + 4% ATK.
佐尔娅降临时的伤害提升至380% + 4% ATK。
Increases Zorya's landing damage to 380% + 4% ATK.
佐尔娅苏醒时受到伤害降低。主动释放时，对面前敌人造成伤害并击倒。

When Zorya awakens, she reduces her damage taken.
Active. Zorya deals damage to enemies in front and knocks them down.
被动地，佐尔娅苏醒时会激活石化皮肤，使自身受到所有伤害降低70%，此效果会在后续10秒内逐渐减弱消失。主动释放时，拟化巨翅虚影，对前方2格扇形范围内的敌方目标造成270% + 30% ATK伤害并将其击倒2秒。

Passive. When Zorya awakens, her skin hardens like stone, reducing her damage taken by 70%. This effect gradually fades over 10s.
Active. Zorya summons arcane wings that sweep forward in a 2-tile arc, dealing 270% + 30% ATK damage to enemies hit and knocking them down for 2s.
主动释放时的伤害提高至280% + 30% ATK。
Increases this skill's damage to 280% + 30% ATK when actively used.
主动释放时的伤害提高至290% + 30% ATK。
Increases this skill's damage to 290% + 30% ATK when actively used.
主动释放时的伤害提高至300% + 30% ATK。
Increases this skill's damage to 300% + 30% ATK when actively used.
佐尔娅苏醒时获得生命汲取。主动释放时，对附近敌人造成多次伤害。
When Zorya awakens, she increases her Life Drain. When this skill is used actively, she deals damage to nearby enemies multiple times.
被动地，佐尔娅苏醒期间获得嗜血，使自身提高20点生命汲取，每当一名敌方英雄在自身2格范围内被击败，自身立即恢复30%最大生命值。主动释放时，对周身2格范围内的所有敌人造成2次85% + 10% ATK伤害，随后对范围内目标进行震慑攻击，造成1次250% + 30% ATK的伤害并附带目标已损生命值15%的额外伤害，最高不超过150% ATK。

Passive. While awake, Zorya gains bloodlust, increasing her Life Drain by 20. Whenever an enemy hero is defeated within 2 tiles, she immediately heals herself for 30% of her max HP.
Active. Zorya deals 85% + 10% ATK damage to all enemies within 2 tiles twice. Then, she launches an intimidating strike on the targets within range, dealing 250% + 30% ATK damage, plus extra damage equal to 15% of their lost HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 150% ATK.
主动释放时的2次伤害提高至90% + 10% ATK，震慑攻击的基础伤害提高至260% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage of the two active strikes to 90% + 10% ATK and the base damage of the intimidating strike to 260% + 30% ATK.
主动释放时的2次伤害提高至95% + 10% ATK，震慑攻击的基础伤害提高至270% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage of the two active strikes to 95% + 10% ATK and the base damage of the intimidating strike to 270% + 30% ATK.
主动释放时的2次伤害提高至100% + 10% ATK，震慑攻击的基础伤害提高至280% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage of the two active strikes to 100% + 10% ATK and the base damage of the intimidating strike to 280% + 30% ATK.
造成伤害提升，附近敌人不少于2名时造成伤害额外提升。
Increases damage dealt, with an extra damage increase when there are 2 or more enemies nearby.
战斗中，自身造成伤害提升9%。自身周围2格内的敌人数量不少于2人时，造成伤害额外提升3%。
Increases damage dealt by 9% during battle. If there are 2 or more enemies within 2 tiles, increases damage dealt by an extra 3%.
战斗中，自身造成伤害提升12%。自身周围2格内的敌人数量不少于2人时，造成伤害额外提升4%。
Increases damage dealt by 12% during battle. If there are 2 or more enemies within 2 tiles, increases damage dealt by an extra 4%.
战斗中，自身造成伤害提升15%。自身周围2格内的敌人数量不少于2人时，造成伤害额外提升5%。
Increases damage dealt by 15% during battle. If there are 2 or more enemies within 2 tiles, increases damage dealt by an extra 5%.
佐尔娅苏醒期间激活镇守力场，降低敌人的移速和急速，并为自身提高高额急速。
While awake, Zorya creates a forcefield that reduces affected enemies' movement speed and Haste, while greatly boosting her own Haste.
佐尔娅苏醒期间，会激活周身2格半径的镇守力场，使其中的所有敌人降低80%的移动速度和60点急速，并使自身的急速提高20点。其他友方英雄每次释放终极技能时，都将使镇守力场的急速加成永久提高15点，最多叠加4次。

While Zorya is awake, she creates a 2-tile forcefield around herself, causing all enemies within it to lose 80% movement speed and 60 Haste, while increasing her own Haste by 20. Whenever an allied hero casts their Ultimate, the Haste bonus from the forcefield permanently increases by 15, stacking up to 4 times.
镇守力场提供的急速提高至30点。
Increases the Haste granted by the forcefield to 30.
自身生命值比例不低于50%时，佐尔娅始终处于霸体状态。
As long as Zorya's HP ratio remains above 50%, she stays unaffected.
镇守力场提供的急速提高至40点。
Increases the Haste granted by the forcefield to 40.
佐尔娅受到最后一击时免于被击败，直接进入休眠状态。
When Zorya takes a fatal blow, she avoids defeat and immediately enters the dormant state.
当佐尔娅遭受最后一击时，将会耗尽精神力免于被击败，立即进入休眠状态。该效果每场战斗只能触发一次。
When Zorya would take a fatal blow, she channels all her Energy to survive and immediately enters her dormant state. This effect can trigger once per battle.
